body.x: STUDIO LAB Co., Ltd. (CEO Sunghoon Kang) participated in CES Unveiled, a global media event held on January 5th (local time) before the official opening of CES 2025.

STUDIO LAB, a startup spun off from Samsung Electronics’ in-house venture program C-Lab in 2021, leverages cutting-edge technologies such as robotics and AI to offer innovative commerce content generation solutions under its vision of "sustainable fashion."

The company first attracted attention in its early days with its AI-powered automated commerce content creation service, 'Seller Canvas.' Last year, STUDIO LAB won the CES 2024 Best of Innovation Award in the AI category. Following this, the company expanded its AI-based business by being selected as a supplier for the "2024 SME Cloud Service Expansion Project."

At CES 2025, STUDIO LAB achieved a second consecutive CES award with its AI photo bot, 'GENCY PB,' which became the Honoree at the CES 2025 Innovation Awards in the Robotics category. During the CES Unveiled pre-event, the technology caught the attention of global media and advanced industry representatives.

The GENCY PB combines AI and robotics technology to automate photography processes, from capturing and editing to printing. Vision AI analyzes specific subjects such as clothing, accessories, or models, identifies optimal shooting angles, generates images and videos, and automates final adjustments and output with minimal user input.

body.cap: STUDIO LAB CEO Sunghoon Kang demonstrates 'GENCY PB' to AVING News reporter Jay Kennedy Marcus at CES Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: GENCY, a service that automatically generates commerce content, was also introduced at the event. By uploading a single photo, users can automate the design of detail pages, product descriptions, and the arrangement of images and text. According to STUDIO LAB, the service enables users to create high-quality commerce content in just 15 seconds.

The GENCY PB offers versatile features for efficiently producing high-quality photo content and functions as an exceptional photo bot for portrait photography. During a previous domestic popup event, visitors gave it positive feedback. Based on this feedback, STUDIO LAB plans to diversify its business into commercial and personal photo content production.

A STUDIO LAB representative said, “It’s an honor to be recognized for global competitiveness in the robotics sector at CES, following last year’s Best of Innovation Award. We are delighted to see our efforts to advance the commerce industry in the global market rewarded with this achievement and media attention.”

The representative added, “STUDIO LAB will continue to refine and advance its unique technologies to compete globally. We aim to expand collaborations with the commerce industry and explore new fields while accelerating the expansion of international markets.”

body.cap: STUDIO LAB CEO Sunghoon Kang introduces 'GENCY PB' to international media representatives at CES Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: STUDIO LAB participated in CES 2025 as part of the Seoul Pavilion in Eureka Park, the startup-focused exhibition area. The Seoul Pavilion, expanded by over 50% from the previous year to 1,040 square meters, features 104 startups. It represents a collaboration between three Seoul districts (Gangnam, Geumcheon, and Gwanak), five startup support organizations (SBA, Seoul Tourism Organization, Seoul Bio Hub, Seoul AI Hub, and Campus Town Growth Center), and eight universities (Konkuk, Kyung Hee, Kookmin, Dongguk, Sogang, Seoul National University of Science and Technology, Yonsei, and Chung-Ang).
AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
